identitySignals: OUSD Legistar file 23-1367 names 'Proxient, Inc.' as the vendor for a web-based budget development system integrated with the Escape platform (software license, July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2025), matching the agenda's 'Proxient Software' service agreement
proxient.com, run by 'Proxient, Inc.', sells Budget Developer, a K-12 budget database, matching OUSD's technology contract for budget software
OUSD's Budget Development Tool login page (bdt.ousd.org) says 'Powered By Proxient Technologies'
research.notes: Contact details are not published on the static proxient.com page; registry IDs not verified (CA SOS and SAM.gov not fetched). Search snippets suggest Benicia, CA but this was not confirmed on a fetched page, so headquarters is null.

profile.summary: A software company that has served K-12 school organizations since 2002. It offers a finance and human resources platform for school districts, including Budget Developer for building budgets, Timetracker for tracking hours and leave, and Budget Explorer for comparing multi-year financial scenarios.

review.notes: proxient.com is Proxient, Inc. and its footer, product list (Budget Developer, Timetracker, Budget Explorer) and finance/HR description for school districts match the summary. OUSD's own bdt.ousd.org budget tool login page says 'Powered By Proxient Technologies', which fits the budget software service agreement.
